speakerNote: MegaDerm is a sheet acellular dermal matrix. HIGHST stocks hydrated and freeze-dried types. The stated thickness and sizes describe HIGHST's inventory. MegaFill is a micronized form of acellular dermal matrix. The photograph is supplied by HIGHST. Individual packages are not assigned type labels.

title: Preoperative Evaluation

rows.head: Blood tests
rows.body:
Blood coagulation tests (PT/PTT)
TTT (testosterone)
Complete blood count (CBC)
Prostate-specific antigen (PSA)
Blood glucose (BST/HbA1c)

rows.head: Screening and other tests
rows.body:
HIV testing
Syphilis testing
Urine testing
Liver enzymes (GOT/GPT/GGT)
Inflammatory markers

rows.head: Penile biothesiometry
rows.body:
Vibration perception threshold
Penile sensitivity assessment

note: IIEF/PEDT 설문, 혈액·감염 검사, 신체진찰·음경 길이 측정·진동각 검사. 혈액응고검사는 PT/PTT, 테스토스테론은 TTT로 표기합니다. 혈당 항목에 BST/HbA1c를 묶고, 수술 전 감염 검사에는 HIV를 포함합니다. 간수치는 GOT/GPT/GGT입니다.
speakerNote:
Preoperative assessment at HIGHST includes IIEF and PEDT questionnaires, flaccid and stretched penile length measurement, and penile biothesiometry.

Laboratory tests
Blood coagulation tests (PT/PTT)
TTT (testosterone)
Complete blood count (CBC)
Prostate-specific antigen (PSA)
Blood glucose (BST/HbA1c)
HIV testing
Syphilis testing
Urine testing
Liver enzymes (GOT/GPT/GGT)
Inflammatory markers

HbA1c denotes glycated hemoglobin and appears under the blood glucose heading.
Sources: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/9187685/ ; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/17568761/ ; https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/diagnostic-tests/a1c-test/ ; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28874780/
